answer.answer: PM SVANidhi offers street vendors a livelihood mechanism through collateral-free working capital loans [E01]. The scheme provides loans of ₹10,000 in the first tranche, ₹20,000 in the second tranche, and ₹50,000 in the third tranche, along with 7% interest subsidy and digital transaction incentives [E01]. From the same ministry (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs), the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) addresses housing shortages for eligible urban households [E03]. PMAY-U was launched on 25th June 2015 and provides pucca houses to eligible urban households in the EWS, LIG, and MIG categories, including slum dwellers, through components like the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme [E03].
